onFocus.zh: 输入元素获得焦点时触发，接收原生 FocusEvent。
onFocus.en: Emitted with the native FocusEvent when the input element receives focus.

onBlur.zh: 输入元素失去焦点时触发，接收原生 FocusEvent；表单上下文同时处理失焦校验。
onBlur.en: Emitted with the native FocusEvent when the input loses focus; the form context also processes blur validation.

onInput.zh: 原生文本输入时触发，接收 Event；新字符串值由 change 和 v-model 更新事件提供。
onInput.en: Emitted with the native Event on text input; change and the v-model update event provide the new string value.

onClick.zh: 可用选项被点击并发出 select 后触发，接收原生 MouseEvent；禁用项不触发。
onClick.en: Emitted with the native MouseEvent after select on an enabled option click; disabled options do not trigger it.

onMouseenter.zh: 鼠标进入可用选项时触发，接收原生 MouseEvent；禁用项不触发。
onMouseenter.en: Emitted with the native MouseEvent when the pointer enters an enabled option; disabled options do not trigger it.
